name: Any table stale > 2 days
_doc: Fires if any tracked table hasn't been loaded in the last 2 days.

name: No load today — page_posts
_doc: page_posts is the most critical table — fire if it didn't load today.

name: Row count dropped > 50%
_doc: Fires if total rows today is < 50% of the 7-day average. Catches truncated loads.
